name: Digital Information Technologies Corporation
summary: Digital Information Technologies Corporation operates as an information services company. The company focuses on commissioned development projects for end-users and information systems in various fields, including finance, pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, distribution, transportation, manufacturing, and the public sector. Its products include WebARGUS, a website security solution; xoBlos, a platform for Excel, which automates inefficient Excel-based tasks; DD-CONNECT, an outsourcing service for electronic contracts.
